verdict.rationale: A probe confirms that Rippling documents an official MCP server on its developer site (rippling-mcp overview). The surrounding developer platform supports agent connections, with Bearer-token and OAuth 2.0 auth, scoped permissions and an llms.txt. However, the pack only shows that the MCP doc page exists, not what the server does. Missing for 10: details of exposed MCP tools/resources and IT-specific coverage, MCP-specific auth/setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.
